cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：服务员
cards.example_en: Our server forgot the soup and apologised at once.
cards.example_zh: 服务员忘了上汤，马上道了歉。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: The young singer forgot a line and then laughed.
cards.example_zh: 那位年轻歌手忘了一句歌词，接着笑了。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: The young soldier wrote a letter home every week.
cards.example_zh: 那位年轻战士每个星期都给家里写信。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：转移；转账
cards.example_en: The bank can transfer the fee straight to the school.
cards.example_zh: 银行可以把这笔费用直接转到学校。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: A factory worker fixed the broken gate before dark.
cards.example_zh: 一名工厂工人在天黑前修好了坏掉的大门。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: The writer signed my book after the library talk.
cards.example_zh: 图书馆讲座结束后，那位作家给我的书签了名。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: She works as a journalist for a newspaper.

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：管理人员
cards.example_en: The executive signed the form that paid for our new lab coats.
cards.example_zh: 那位管理人员签了字，批下了新实验服的钱。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：创新的
cards.example_en: The science club built an innovative model of a bridge.
cards.example_zh: 科学社团做了一个创新的桥梁模型。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：主要地
cards.example_en: The plan worked largely because everyone helped.
cards.example_zh: 计划能成，主要是因为大家都帮了忙。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：每月的
cards.example_en: Our monthly test covers maths and science on the first Monday.
cards.example_zh: 我们的月考在第一个星期一考数学和科学。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：部分地

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: She smiled in acknowledgment when the teacher praised her.
cards.example_zh: 老师表扬她时，她微笑着点头回应。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: Dad's retirement party filled the living room with friends.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸的退休聚会让客厅里挤满了朋友。

cards.scene: 工作职业 · Work and Jobs
cards.example_en: My uncle runs a small business near the market.
cards.example_zh: 我叔叔在市场附近做着小生意。
